title: Inicio operativo, arranque limpio y configuración rápida de horarios

decisions.cleanStart: Fresh 2j_platform_local has no synthetic business activity. Existing databases are never deleted or cleaned automatically.
decisions.demo: Existing additive seed remains opt-in, dev/test-only, loopback-only, and restricted to database 2j_demo.
decisions.scheduleModel: Reuse recurring_session_templates; batch create templates only; session generation remains explicit.
decisions.conflicts: Reject internal and active-template overlapping intervals for the same service or assigned professional; batch is atomic and serialized.
decisions.dashboard: Today sessions are ordered by start time and contain service/professional labels and aggregate seat/waitlist counts only; no client PII.

verification.githubChecks: Quality and secret scan are required; the linked PR checks are the live source of truth.

scopeGuard: No 2jfitnessapp changes, no product vertical expansion, no deletion of existing database data, no automatic session generation, no auto-merge.
